subject: arrow sign on selectInput multiple = TRUE

messages.author: e0ebbc321704f022
messages.subject: arrow sign on selectInput multiple = TRUE
parts:
Hello,

I wanted to point out that I want to use selectInput with multiple = TRUE but it resides on the user interface as just a blank box where user can understand there are options to select from only when clicked on the box as a dropdown menu. I would like to have an arrow sign on the box giving the hint of there is an interactive box there. Now it only looks as a box created by some leftover code and forgotten to be fixed. Thanks for your time

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: arrow sign on selectInput multiple = TRUE
parts:
If you use selectize=FALSE, multiple options will be shown even before it's clicked, as in the example in the upper-right here:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/selectize-vs-select.html
